collect.title: What data we collect
collect.intro: When you create an account on Collectify, we collect:

items.email: Your email address (used to sign in and identify your account)
items.names: A username and full name you choose
items.password: A password (stored as a secure hash - we never store your password in plain text), unless you sign up via GitHub or Google, in which case we store a linked account ID instead
items.profile: Optional profile info you add: avatar image, banner image, bio/description, country and city, and date of birth
items.content: Content you create while using the app: collections, items, comments, likes, follows, messages, and notifications

why.title: Why we collect it
why.text: Your data is used to create and manage your account, authenticate you when you log in, keep you signed in between visits (session management), and to provide the core features of the app - collections, following other users, comments, likes, and messaging.

location.title: Location and date of birth
location.intro: Both are optional and can be changed or removed at any time in your profile.

items.location: Country and city are shown on your public profile and are used to suggest people you may know who live in the same city. We do not collect your precise location or IP-based location.
items.birthDate: Date of birth is private: it is never shown to other users. It is used only to confirm that you meet the minimum age.

recommendations.title: Recommendations
recommendations.text: To build your “For you” feed, board suggestions and “People you may know”, we use the categories you pick as interests, the collections you like, save, put on boards or open while signed in, the tags and categories of those collections, the people you follow and who follow you, and the city in your profile. We remember which collections you have liked or saved even after you undo it, so they are not suggested to you again. This happens inside Collectify only; boards and your viewing history are never shown to other users.

age.title: Minimum age
age.text: Collectify is intended for people who are 18 or older, and you confirm your age when you sign up. A date of birth that makes you younger than 18 cannot be saved. If we learn that an account belongs to someone under 18, we may suspend it and delete its data.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: We use only the cookies and browser storage needed to keep you signed in and remember your settings - no analytics, tracking or advertising cookies. The full list is in the <cookies>Cookie Policy</cookies>.

moderation.title: Reports and moderation
moderation.text: When you report content, we keep a copy of the reported comment or collection so moderators can review it even if it is later deleted. Moderators and administrators may review reported content and an account’s public activity when handling a report. Direct messages cannot be reported, and moderators and administrators cannot read your conversations. Moderation actions are recorded in an internal audit log. When an account is deleted, its content is deleted too; the audit log keeps only the account ID and username.

thirdParties.title: Third parties
thirdParties.text: We do not sell or share your data with third parties for advertising or marketing purposes. If you choose to sign up or log in with GitHub or Google, those providers share basic profile information (such as your email) with us to create your account.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.text: {operator} runs Collectify and is responsible for your personal data (the “controller”).
controller.noEmail: Our contact details are in the <legal>Legal notice</legal>.

legalBases.title: Legal bases
legalBases.text: We process your data to provide the service you signed up for (performance of a contract, Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR): your account, your content, messages and account emails. Security, preventing abuse, moderation, rate limits and recommendations rely on our legitimate interest in running a safe and relevant service (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Optional profile details are used because you chose to add them, and you can remove them at any time.

processors.title: Service providers
processors.intro: We use these providers to run Collectify. They process data only on our behalf:

items.hosting: Vercel - hosting of the website and API
items.images: Uploadcare - storage and delivery of uploaded images
items.realtime: Pusher - real-time delivery of messages and notifications
items.signIn: Google and GitHub - sign-in, only if you choose to use them

processors.transfers: Some of these providers process data outside the European Economic Area, for example in the United States.

externalImages.title: Images from other websites
externalImages.text: Collections can show images hosted on other websites, such as cover art. When your browser loads them, those websites receive your IP address and browser details, as with any web page.

retention.title: How long we keep data
retention.text: We keep your data while your account exists. Sessions expire after 14 days, password reset links after 1 hour and confirmation links after 3 days. IP addresses used for rate limiting are kept for at most one hour. When you delete your account, your profile, collections, comments, likes, follows, boards and chats are deleted right away, and so are the images you uploaded; the moderation log keeps only your account ID and username.
retention.textKeepsUploads: We keep your data while your account exists. Sessions expire after 14 days, password reset links after 1 hour and confirmation links after 3 days. IP addresses used for rate limiting are kept for at most one hour. When you delete your account, your profile, collections, comments, likes, follows, boards and chats are deleted right away; the moderation log keeps only your account ID and username. Images you uploaded may stay on our image host until we remove them; contact us if you want that done sooner.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can download a copy of your data and delete your account in <settings>Settings</settings>, and correct your data in your profile. You can also object to processing based on our legitimate interest and complain to your data protection authority. For anything else, contact us using the details above.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.text: If we change this policy, we update the date at the top. We will let you know about significant changes before they take effect.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms are an agreement between you and {operator} (“we”) about using Collectify. By creating an account or using the site, you accept them. Please also read our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>, which explains how we handle your data.

eligibility.title: Who can use Collectify
eligibility.text: You must be 18 or older and confirm it when you sign up. You may not use Collectify if we have banned you, and you may not create accounts automatically.

account.title: Your account
account.text: Keep your password safe and your email address up to date. You are responsible for what happens under your account; tell us right away if you think someone else has access to it.

content.title: Your content
content.text: Collections, items, comments, images and messages you add stay yours. To run the service, you give us a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to host, store, reproduce and display your content on Collectify and in link previews of it, for as long as it is on the service. The licence ends when you delete the content, except for copies we must keep for moderation, legal reasons or in backups for a limited time.

rights.title: What you may post
rights.text: Only post content you have the right to share. When you add images or links from other websites, make sure that is allowed, and do not post other people’s personal data without their permission.

conduct.title: What is not allowed
conduct.text: Do not post or send anything illegal; harassment, threats or hate speech; sexual content involving minors; spam, scams or deliberately misleading content; malware; or content that infringes someone else’s rights. Do not try to break, overload, scrape or bypass the security of Collectify.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.text: We may review reported content, remove content that breaks these terms or the law, and restrict or ban accounts, temporarily or permanently. When we restrict your account, we tell you in the app. If you think we made a mistake, contact us.

copyright.title: Copyright complaints
copyright.text: If you believe content on Collectify infringes your rights, report it in the app or contact us with a link to the content and details of your rights. We remove content that is clearly infringing.

price.title: Price
price.text: Collectify is free to use. There are no paid plans, purchases or hidden fees, so there is nothing to refund. If we ever add paid features, we will show the price and the refund terms before you pay.

service.title: Changes to the service
service.text: We keep improving Collectify, so features may change or be removed. We may pause the service for maintenance or when we have to.

termination.title: Closing your account
termination.text: You can delete your account at any time in <settings>Settings</settings>; your data is then deleted as described in the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>. We may suspend or close accounts that seriously or repeatedly break these terms.

disclaimer.title: No warranty
disclaimer.text: Collectify is provided “as is”. We work to keep it available and secure, but we cannot promise it will always be available or free of errors. Content is created by users, and we do not endorse it.

liability.title: Liability
liability.text: To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, or for losses caused by other users’ content or actions. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, or your rights as a consumer.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.text: If we change these terms, we update the date above. We will let you know about significant changes before they take effect; if you keep using Collectify after that, the new terms apply.

law.title: Governing law
law.text: These terms are governed by the law of the country where the operator of Collectify is established. If you are a consumer, you also keep the protection of the mandatory laws of the country where you live.
law.country: These terms are governed by the law of {country}. If you are a consumer, you also keep the protection of the mandatory laws of the country where you live.

cookiePolicy.intro: Collectify uses only the cookies and browser storage it needs to work and to remember choices you make. There are no advertising or tracking cookies, and nothing is shared with advertisers.

cookiePolicy.consentText: All of these are strictly necessary to provide the service you asked for or remember a choice you made, so the law does not require your consent for them. If we ever add optional cookies, such as analytics, we will ask first, and they will stay off unless you say yes.
